cases.why: A plan-approval escalation the active mandate already covers is the operator's to approve; interrupting the human for it is the failure mode this note exists to prevent.
No mandate covers this plan, so it is product ambiguity in effect: the operator asks.
risk:high is never auto-permitted (AGENTS.md Mandate); it is always an ask regardless of mandate.
A capped revision ladder is an operational fault, not a call the operator can make on the parent's behalf.
A USD cap (or a token cap at the ceiling) pauses the mandate; resuming spend is the human's money to authorize again.
Merge permission is the repository's; a refusal is relayed, not resolved by the operator.
Ending the mission is a human call, never a bounded-authority default.
Work outside what the mandate named is exactly what scope expansion means.
